jobs.title: Inside Sales & Business Development Executive
jobs.description:
**Company:** S.S Enterprise (SOLIT)  
**Location:** Chennai  
**Department:** Sales \& Business Development  
**Job Type:** Full\-time, Primarily Office\-based

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, target\-driven Inside Sales \& Business Development Executive to manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and initial client communication to quotation preparation, negotiation and order closure.

The candidate will primarily operate from the office and independently handle their assigned clients. Client visits and meetings may be required whenever necessary to develop business opportunities and close deals.

The candidate will be responsible for managing clients from the first point of contact until the successful closure of the order, ensuring consistent communication and follow\-ups throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Lead Generation \& Cold Calling**

* Make a high volume of outbound sales calls daily.
* Identify and generate new business leads independently.
* Contact potential customers, builders, contractors, architects, industries, institutions and government\-related prospects.
* Explore new business opportunities through online research, directories, referrals and other sources.
* Build and maintain a database of prospective clients.

**2\. Complete Client Management**

* Independently handle clients from initial enquiry to final order confirmation.
* Understand client requirements and recommend suitable products and solutions.
* Maintain regular communication and follow up with every prospective client.
* Build long\-term relationships with customers.
* Arrange client meetings and site visits whenever required.

**3\. Quotation \& Commercial Management**

* Prepare and share quotations based on client requirements.
* Coordinate internally for product specifications, pricing and technical details.
* Handle commercial discussions, negotiations and price revisions.
* Send revised quotations and follow up until order confirmation.
* Coordinate with the accounts and operations teams for order processing.

**4\. Sales Conversion \& Order Closure**

* Convert generated leads into confirmed business.
* Follow up consistently on pending quotations and enquiries.
* Identify potential bulk orders and project opportunities.
* Achieve assigned monthly sales targets.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

**5\. Reporting \& CRM Management**

* Maintain daily records of calls, enquiries, leads and follow\-ups.
* Update the lead management system regularly.
* Submit daily sales activity and performance reports.
* Track every client until the opportunity is closed or formally lost.

Work Structure

* Primarily office\-based.
* Daily outbound calls and lead generation are essential.
* Client visits and meetings whenever required.
* Complete ownership of assigned clients and sales opportunities.
* Responsible for the entire sales process, not just lead generation or appointment setting.

Candidate Requirements

* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Confidence in making cold calls and approaching new customers.
* Ability to independently generate leads.
* Good email, WhatsApp and computer skills.
* Basic knowledge of Excel and quotation preparation.
* Self\-motivated, disciplined and target\-oriented.
* Prior experience in B2B sales, electricals, solar, construction, infrastructure or industrial products will be an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of productive outbound calls.
* Number of new leads generated independently.
* Number of quotations prepared and shared.
* Quality and consistency of client follow\-ups.
* Number of client meetings arranged.
* Enquiry\-to\-order conversion ratio.
* Monthly sales revenue and order closures.

**Important:** The candidate will have complete ownership of their assigned clients, from the first sales call to final order closure. We are looking for someone who takes responsibility for generating business rather than waiting for enquiries to come
